Customer ticket:
Dear Northwind Outdoor Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to respectfully report an issue regarding my recent purchase of a camping tent. Unfortunately, upon unpacking it, I discovered a significant tear in the waterproof coating. I understand that your policy requires damaged items to be returned within 10 days, and I have already initiated the return process to ensure I am well within that timeframe. However, I am concerned about the refund amount. The tent cost $650.00, but I noticed that full refunds are capped at $500.00 per item. Given that the item was defective upon arrival, I was hoping for a full reimbursement of the purchase price rather than a partial refund. Could you please clarify if there are any exceptions to this cap for manufacturing defects? I have always appreciated your excellent service and would love to resolve this matter amicably. Thank you for your time and assistance.

Sincerely,
Arthur

Reference standard — key facts a correct reply must convey:
- You must return damaged items within 10 days.
- Full refunds are capped at $500.00 per item.

Handbook sections that cover this answer:
### damaged_items
# Damaged Items

1. You must report any visible damage to your Northwind Outdoor order within 48 hours of delivery. To initiate a claim, log into your account and select the "Report Damage" option. You are required to upload at least 3 high-resolution photos showing the specific defect, the overall item, and the shipping packaging. Failure to provide this visual evidence within the 48-hour window will result in an automatic denial of the claim, as we cannot verify the condition of the item after it has been used or stored.

2. If the damage is minor, such as a small scratch on a bike frame or a loose stitching on a tent fly, we will offer a 15% discount on your next purchase as a goodwill gesture. This discount is applied automatically to your account and is valid for 30 days. For major structural failures, such as a cracked wheel rim or a torn tent pole, we will issue a full refund of the item’s price, up to a maximum of $500.00 per item. Items exceeding this value require a manual review by our senior support team, which may take up to 5 business days to process.

3. When we approve a full refund or replacement, you must ship the damaged item back to our warehouse within 10 days of receiving the return authorization label. We will provide a prepaid shipping label for items under 20 lbs. For heavier items, such as mountain bikes or large camping stoves, you must arrange your own freight pickup. We will reimburse up to 50% of the shipping cost, capped at $75.00, provided you submit the original receipt within 14 days of the pickup date.

4. If the damage is caused by improper use, such as overloading a bike rack beyond its 150 lb capacity limit or using a camping stove in a non-ventilated area, the claim will be denied. We reserve the right to inspect the item upon return. If our inspection reveals signs of misuse or neglect, we will notify you within 3 business days. In such cases, you will be responsible for the return shipping costs, which typically range from $15.00 to $40.00 depending on the item’s weight and dimensions.

5. For items that are partially damaged but still functional, we may offer a repair service at no cost to you. This includes replacing broken zippers on backpacks or fixing bent handlebars on bikes. The repair process takes approximately 7 to 10 business days. During this time, you may request a loaner item if available, subject to a $20.00 deposit that is refunded upon the return of the loaner in good condition.

## Key facts

- You have 48 hours to report damage with 3 photos.
- Minor damage earns a 15% discount valid for 30 days.
- Full refunds are capped at $500.00 per item.
- You must return damaged items within 10 days.
- Misuse claims are denied, and you pay return shipping.

### warranty
# Warranty

Northwind Outdoor stands behind the quality of every bike and camping item we sell. Our warranty policy is designed to give you peace of mind while you explore the outdoors. Please review the following terms carefully before making a purchase.

1. **Standard Coverage Period**: All new bikes, tents, and sleeping bags come with a standard 2-year warranty from the date of original purchase. This coverage includes defects in materials and workmanship under normal use. If a defect is found within this 730-day window, we will repair or replace the item at no cost to you.

2. **Extended Warranty Option**: For an additional 15% of the original purchase price, you can upgrade to a 5-year extended warranty. This option is available only within the first 30 days of purchase. The extended warranty covers the same defects as the standard plan but extends the protection period to 1,825 days, ensuring long-term reliability for high-value gear.

3. **Repair Service Fees**: If your item is outside the warranty period or the damage is due to misuse, we offer a repair service. A flat diagnostic fee of $25 applies to all repair requests. If you approve the repair, this $25 fee is credited toward the final invoice. If you decline the repair, the diagnostic fee is non-refundable.

4. **Wear and Tear Exclusions**: Normal wear and tear, such as fabric fading, minor scratches, or zipper stiffness, is not covered under warranty. However, if a zipper fails completely within the first 90 days, we will replace the zipper free of charge. After 90 days, zipper replacements cost $15 per unit, plus shipping.

5. **Claim Processing Time**: Once we receive your warranty claim and the item, we will inspect it within 5 business days. If the claim is approved, we will ship the replacement or repaired item within 10 business days of the inspection completion. Please allow an additional 3 to 5 days for transit depending on your location.

6. **Transferability**: The standard 2-year warranty is non-transferable. If you sell your Northwind Outdoor gear, the warranty voids immediately upon transfer of ownership. However, the extended 5-year warranty is transferable to one subsequent owner, provided the new owner registers the item within 14 days of purchase.

## Key facts

- The standard warranty lasts for 2 years (730 days) from the purchase date.
- You can extend coverage to 5 years for 15% of the original price within 30 days.
- A $25 diagnostic fee applies to out-of-warranty repairs, credited if you proceed.
- Zipper failures within the first 90 days are replaced free of charge.
- Warranty claims are inspected within 5 business days of receipt.

Assistant reply to grade:
Based on the handbook excerpts provided, I cannot confirm any exceptions to the refund cap for manufacturing defects. The policy states that for major structural failures, a full refund is issued up to a maximum of $500.00 per item [damaged_items.2]. It explicitly notes that items exceeding this value require a manual review by the senior support team, which may take up to 5 business days to process [damaged_items.2].

Since your tent costs $650.00, it exceeds the $500.00 automatic cap and will require this manual review. The handbook does not specify whether the manual review results in a full reimbursement of the purchase price or if the cap remains in effect after review.

Additionally, please ensure you have reported the damage within 48 hours of delivery and uploaded at least 3 high-resolution photos (showing the specific defect, the overall item, and the shipping packaging) to avoid automatic denial of the claim [damaged_items.1].

As the handbook does not clarify the outcome of the manual review for items over $500.00, I recommend escalating this ticket to a human agent who can provide a definitive answer regarding the specific refund amount for your $650.00 tent.

did_not_answer.description: true if the reply does not answer the customer's actual question

missing_points.description: key facts from the reference standard that are omitted or stated inaccurately
missing_points.title: Missing Points

note.description: ONE short sentence describing the single most important problem (the open-coding note)
note.title: Note

pass.description: true only if every key fact is stated, every claim is supported, nothing is over-promised and the question is answered
pass.title: Pass

unsupported_claims.description: claims in the reply the handbook sections do not support
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

wrong_tone_or_promise.description: true if the reply promises/implies something the handbook does not allow
wrong_tone_or_promise.title: Wrong Tone Or Promise
